s1.syndrome_frame: Acute abdominal syndrome with signs of inflammation and possible infection, characterized by abdominal pain, nausea, and fever, with a history of chronic hematologic abnormalities
salient_findings: Recurrent right abdomen pain progressing to involve the entire abdomen
Diffuse tenderness with rebound tenderness, primarily in the right abdomen
Edematous thickening of the intestinal wall in the ascending colon with peripheral exudative changes on CT scan
Growth of Escherichia coli in ascites culture
key_facts: Patient has a history of Hashimoto's thyroiditis and thrombocytopenia
Patient has consistently shown leukocytopenia and thrombocytopenia in routine blood tests
Initial blood test revealed a leukocyte count of 3.16 × 10^9/L and a platelet count of 109.00 × 10^9/L
Patient experienced intermittent abdominal pain and occasional nausea four hours post-procedure
Patient experienced recurrent right abdomen pain progressing to involve the entire abdomen, with persistent nausea and perceived increase in body temperature
Initial examination showed tenderness in the right abdomen, without rebound tenderness and muscular tension, with normal bowel sounds
Later examination revealed diffuse tenderness with rebound tenderness, primarily in the right abdomen
Dullness to percussion was observed, while pain during percussion in the liver area was absent
Shifting dullness to percussion was negative, and normal bowel sounds were detected
Maximum body temperature was 37.8°C
WBC count was 3.43 × 10^9/L, with neutrophil percentage of 85.40% and lymphocyte percentage of 9.40%
CRP level was 2.45 mg/L, and procalcitonin level was 0.58 ng/ml
CT scan showed edematous thickening of the intestinal wall in the ascending colon with peripheral exudative changes
Follow-up CT showed distension of anterior wall of ascending colon with gas, exudation in subserosa of middle section, and small quantity of ascites
Ascites culture yielded growth of Escherichia coli
Histological examination showed edema in all layers of intestinal wall, predominant thickening and edema in submucosa, diffuse infiltration of neutrophils with presence of abscesses

shortlist.label: Neutropenic colitis
shortlist.why_kept: Patient has a history of leukocytopenia and thrombocytopenia, and presented with abdominal pain, nausea, and signs of inflammation, which are consistent with neutropenic colitis

shortlist.label: Typhlitis

shortlist.label: Intra-abdominal abscess
shortlist.why_kept: Patient had a positive ascites culture for Escherichia coli and presented with abdominal pain, nausea, and signs of inflammation, which are consistent with an intra-abdominal abscess

shortlist.label: Peritonitis
shortlist.why_kept: Patient presented with abdominal pain, nausea, and signs of inflammation, including rebound tenderness and diffuse tenderness, which are consistent with peritonitis

shortlist.label: Clostridioides difficile colitis
shortlist.why_kept: Patient presented with abdominal pain, nausea, and signs of inflammation, and had a history of recent procedure, which increases the risk of Clostridioides difficile infection
